Can we use a standard contract for keyed nonces (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12440)  in devnet-1? cc <@725415098331430932> <@792404665068158998> for the review comments on the PR. 

If so can we do the same for recent roots? Then https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12406 isn't needed at all, and we end up with 3 contracts deployed, one for each EIP.

cc <@543900561460822016> <@276430601085517835> <@281967554572976128> <@830368514225340436> 

Would be good to align on what to do for these so we can still get a test release out for Monday!
